A custom data_as_elements list names the elements to convert

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<div><section data-as="p">First</section><section data-as="p">Second</section></div>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(data_as_elements: ['section']))
puts result.content.inspect
```
